tvShow.name: Caught in the Act: Unfaithful
tvShow.overview: Host Tami Roman sets out on a mission geared at empowering suspicious lovers in catching their cheating partners whle in the middle of the act. With a little help from relationship expert Kevin Carr and private investigator Brianne Joseph, she manages to uncover both the truth and the receipts required to expose the cheats. If caught cheating, the show gives the victims of infidelity a choice when it comes to bringing justice: they can team up with the other lover, or ambush both the partner and their lover together.

episodes.name: He Ain't Eating That Much Pie
episodes.overview: When Tracy's boyfriend of two years, McKinley, goes from being attentive to evasive, her intuition pushes her to seek out Tami and her crew of relationship experts for help.

episodes.name: He Just Wanna Be Lit... But Not With Me
episodes.overview: Three weeks after meeting on an internet dating site, Naima and David were an inseparable couple, but a year later, Naima suspects David of telling a web of lies, and he may be a cheater. Tami is on the case when Naima's boyfriend David moves out of their house and later shares a provocative video of another woman in his new apartment.

episodes.name: Did You Cross That Bridge?
episodes.overview: Marlo explored his sexuality and accepted his attraction to men by falling for Corey. After seven years together, Marlo is contemplating making a lifetime commitment to dance instructor boyfriend Corey, but Marlo suspects Corey might be a cheater and he wants Corey to face the music.

episodes.name: An Insatiable Appetite for Success
episodes.overview: Jessica's fears about her boyfriend Walter's possible infidelity are complicated by the fact that they're also business partners, but she finds support and loyalty from an unexpected source.

episodes.name: She Has a Whole Other Apartment?
episodes.overview: Gierra has spent nearly five years in love with Shay's swagger, but the romance seems to be fizzling after a move to Atlanta, so she turns to Tami to find out what's behind the strain.

episodes.name: Not Her Cousin!
episodes.overview: Nico walked into Leighann's shop looking for a haircut and wound up in a long-distance relationship with a baby on the way, but now he's starting to worry about her other clients and her ex.

episodes.name: It's Giving Very Much Fraudulent
episodes.overview: Monika seeks Tami's help to investigate if her gym manager husband has been sweating it out in the gym or sweating another woman.

episodes.name: He Proposed to Both of Us
episodes.overview: Leila, a model from Switzerland, was swept off her feet when she met West four years ago; lately, West has been moving differently, leading Leila to believe that her dream man might be stepping out on her.

episodes.name: We Have Dogs at Home
episodes.overview: Neko has been friends with Kara for 10 years, so by the time they started dating a year ago, he trusted her completely; ever since Kara became a stripper-barber, Neko has begun to suspect she's been crossing the line.

episodes.name: No Way To Treat A Lady
episodes.overview: Bella thought she found the man of her dreams with her live-in lover Aaron but begins second guessing herself when she suspects he may be cheating with his social media star friend William.

episodes.name: You Gave Up the Cookies!
episodes.overview: For almost three years, Mariah's been living with her boyfriend and her son's father; despite being showered by Bobby's love, Mariah experiences a shocking indecent that has her questioning if there's someone else.

episodes.name: Any Old D Will Do
episodes.overview: Twenty-year-old Andrew has been working night and day to start a family with his girlfriend Nikki, but lately he's become suspicious that she may be stepping out on him with her yoga instructor.

episodes.name: He Said That Was His Cousin
episodes.overview: Mimi, a dancer who works late nights, has been seeing some shady behavior lately from Memphis, her boyfriend of six years; Mimi wants Tami to do a little digging to find out if her suspicions are valid.

episodes.name: I Just Don't Feel That Bad
episodes.overview: Ruby and Johnny found a common interest in photography but Ruby feels like Johnny isn't as focused on her as he should be.

episodes.name: Dropping All Kinds of Eggplants
episodes.overview: Before moving forward with intensive fertility treatments, Suspicious Lover Star wants to make sure her much younger boyfriend Ricky is committed to her and their future child.

episodes.name: I Feel Like a Side Chick Almost
episodes.overview: Jessica thinks her relationship with her music man is in perfect harmony, until she suspects the bond with his best friend might be causing him to change his tune.

episodes.name: What is the Gardener Doing Here?
episodes.overview: Kori seeks Tami's help to find out if her boyfriend George is cheating on her, but things take a turn when Tami realises she's one of the pawns in the scheme.

episodes.name: We Got a Runner
episodes.overview: Nia and her mother, Aida, are anxious for Nia's upcoming wedding to William. But Nia suspects that when William makes house calls for his massage service, he may be providing more than relaxation.

episodes.name: She Has Two Phones!
episodes.overview: Richard, a comedian and content creator, is trying to take things seriously with Elisa, his model girlfriend of one year. Given his recent experiences with grief, he's concerned that life's too short to ignore all the red flags.

episodes.name: That's My Ex-Best Friend
episodes.overview: Joe, Lexi's boyfriend of five years, has been helping with her modelling career; recently, she's begun to suspect that Joe has eyes for another woman.

episodes.name: It's An R&B Love Story
episodes.overview: Cortez transforms himself from a skinny kid with no confidence to a full-fledged stud.

episodes.name: She Ain't Even That Cute!
episodes.overview: Sky and Ted have been together for 17 years, but Sky is fearful that Ted is stepping out on her.

episodes.name: Is That Your Auntie?
episodes.overview: Dani, a hard-working single mom, has been dating Rio for three years and his suspected infidelities put her daughter's happiness at risk, forcing her to decide if she should confront Rio.

episodes.name: You Will NEVER Touch Me Again
episodes.overview: Bryant has been in a long-distance relationship with Eric for a year and wants Eric to move in with him, but he's in for a big surprise.

episodes.name: Unfortunately... She's My Wife
episodes.overview: After 18 years, five kids and mutual infidelities in their past, Jennifer suspects her husband Sal is back to his old creeping ways, putting everything they've worked for on the line.

episodes.name: He Done Knocked Ken Down
episodes.overview: Jamison's fiancée Juliette has refused to set a wedding date for nine years and he suspects her longtime pal and hairstylist is to blame, but it's soon revealed there's more to the story.

episodes.name: She Must Not Know About Me
episodes.overview: Ciara has been fully dedicated to her relationship with her boyfriend, Kwame. But recent changes in his attitude lead her to believe that he might not be as committed as she is.

episodes.name: Toxic, Dysfunctional Love
episodes.overview: With a wedding on the horizon, larger-than-life TV personality Redd suspects her fiancée is stepping outside of their nine-year relationship with another woman—who happens to be a mutual friend.

episodes.name: There's No Future in Frontin'
episodes.overview: Sicorra thinks her rapper boyfriend's playboy persona is just for the stage, but she suspects that art imitates life and that he may actually be cheating on her.

episodes.name: That's called Pandora's Box
episodes.overview: Emily and Brandon have been in a committed-albeit unconventional-relationship for six years.

episodes.name: Who Was That Woman, Doctor?
episodes.overview: Jessica fell fast for Deyondrick, AKA DJ Mula. Deyondrick is fully integrated into Jessica's life, her kids' lives, and their home. But now Jessica is suspicious of Deyondrick's best friend, and ex, Katelyn AKA Yogi Bear.

episodes.name: That's My Twin
episodes.overview: Alex is ready to lock it down with La'Niece and their blended family. But he has a hunch La'Niece is creeping around. He hits up Tami to find out if La'Niece is the one, or if she's double dipping.

episodes.name: Where's My Pizza and Wine?
episodes.overview: Male model Marquis and his boyfriend Arthur were each other's firsts and eight years later, they're still together; but lately, Marquis suspects Arthur is stepping out, so he calls on Tami to find out if his suspicions are real.

episodes.name: I'm Marrying Both of Them
episodes.overview: Vanna was drawn to Stone's sweet musical sound during their courtship, but now she needs Tami's help to find out if Stone is no longer interested in a duet.

episodes.name: Too Beautiful to Be Crying
episodes.overview: R. Guy and Ja'Van have had a fairytale romance for six years; Ja'Van's been leaving for days at a time and funds have gone missing; worried happily ever after may never come, R. Guy seeks Tami's help.

episodes.name: Meet My Team
episodes.overview: Max is ready to retire and live out his golden years with his blonde bombshell girlfriend, Melissa. But he's suspicious about her long workouts and elevated sex drive that seem to be more of a priority.

episodes.name: She For The Streetz
episodes.overview: Trey is ready to build a future with his girlfriend, Alicia, but he's worried something is holding her back; after Tami puts her team on the case, it seems Trey's concerns may hit even closer to home than he feared.

episodes.name: A Big Load of Hogwash
episodes.overview: RJ needs Tami's help to find out if his fiancé Marisa is committed to getting married or planning to be a runaway bride.

episodes.name: Coach Ken, You Not Making It Easy
episodes.overview: Alexis thought she and her boyfriend Ben were on the same timeline, but needs Tami's help to find out if her time with him is really up.

episodes.name: You Are the Drama!
episodes.overview: Miniyah manages her girlfriend Jay's bookings as a private dancer; Jay's sudden need for space has her moving out of their home; Miniyah starts to question their future.

episodes.name: Is This a Hotel or a Motel?
episodes.overview: Eric thinks he's a part of a power couple, but his instincts lead him to seek Tami's help to see if the Bonnie to his Clyde is making power moves with another man.

episodes.name: He Got a Type
episodes.overview: When Viva met Michael, he provided a safe place away from family drama, but now her safety bubble seems like it's about to pop; Michael is pulling away and Viva is desperate to find out if he's hiding something or perhaps someone.

episodes.name: On the Food Truck
episodes.overview: Loyalties and friendships are tested when betrayal is on the menu; private chef, Shay, suspects her longtime boyfriend, Tony, is serving up more than food at his food truck; Tami and her team helps Shay get to the bottom of Tony.

episodes.name: I'm an Icon in the Ballroom Scene
episodes.overview: Alexis and Trenton meet in the ballroom scene; but after seeing how close Trenton has gotten with his new protege, Alexis wonders if Trenton is just being friendly or if there are now three in their tango.

episodes.name: She Just Greedy, I Guess
episodes.overview: Porceyon needs Tami's help to find out if his wife Shamika is really selling products at her pop-up shops or using the time to pop off with another guy.

episodes.name: Don't Forget Your Guilt Gift
episodes.overview: Skittles' boyfriend Edward satisfies his love language of gift giving, but Skittles is still skeptical about Edward becoming stepfather to his kids; before taking that step, Skittles needs to find out if Edward is spoiling someone else on the side.

episodes.name: Un-Communicated Expectations
episodes.overview: Eric met Angel during a model shoot and they've been in love ever since; their spark seems to be fading; determined to get things back on track, Eric turns to Tami to help figure out where the magic went.

episodes.name: Menage a Trois
episodes.overview: Marie loves her routine tantra massages from her boyfriend of five years, Antoine. Marie has grown suspicious that Antoine is sharing his healing touch with other women after launching his latest service, the Menage a Trois.

episodes.name: Let's Put It on Pause
episodes.overview: After three years, Sasha and Citi are planning their future and considering having a baby together; Citi tells Sasha to get back on her birth control making her wonder if Citi is now imagining a future with someone else.

episodes.name: Side Chicks Never Complain
episodes.overview: Kayla mixes business with pleasure investing into a business venture with her older boyfriend, Daniel; Daniel's been shady lately, so Kayla turns to Tami to learn if she's being hustled in love and money.

episodes.name: Love in the Comedy Club
episodes.overview: Comedienne Vonda is not amused by her suspicion that her stripper boyfriend, Brian, is playing her for a fool.

episodes.name: I'm the Entree, You're the Cole Slaw
episodes.overview: A year ago, Romeo helps hot-tempered Briana find love again after she suffers a loss; Briana is suspicious that Romeo may be finding love elsewhere.

episodes.name: She's a Runner, She's a Track Star
episodes.overview: Born into a family of athletes, Jasmine has always dreamed of taking her talent for track all the way; when she falls for her trainer, she wonders what's to stop him from crossing the line with his other clients.

episodes.name: Love Is an Irregular Shape
episodes.overview: After reconnecting with a high school friend, Jon is looking towards marriage and building a life together with Joseph; but recent changes and mystery phone calls have Jon concerned that she might not be the only one Joseph is connecting with.

episodes.name: Just Girls Being Girls
episodes.overview: Gianni always knew he was Alondra's first, but after Tami uncovers the truth, he may soon realize he just might be her last.

episodes.name: You Gotta Run Faster Than That, Ken
episodes.overview: Lisa suspects live-in lover and hookah business partner and Joseph, may be cheating on her and their dog Chloe.

episodes.name: Kriss Kross, You Can Have Her
episodes.overview: While trying to repair his five year relationship after stepping out, Bryce wonders if his girlfriend is serving up a dose of Katie Karma behind his back.

episodes.name: Kriss Kross, You Can Have He
episodes.overview: While trying to repair his five year relationship after stepping out, Bryce wonders if his girlfriend is serving up a dose of Katie Karma behind his back.

episodes.name: I'm Royalty, This Is Beyond Me
episodes.overview: Career-minded Colombian singer Kat suspects her boyfriend, producer, rapper, Andre, is doing more than making music with the female artists he produces.

episodes.name: My Man, My Man, My Man
My Dream House
episodes.overview: Quinn believes Deonta is her soulmate, but notices him growing distant. He has already met her kids, and Quinn is ready for a ring. Quinn is ready to find out what's making Deonta so cold.

episodes.name: Crash Out Or Pass Out
episodes.overview: Dashaye seeks Tami's help when she suspects her longtime girlfriend, Danielle, is creeping around. When Dashaye confronts Danielle, another plot twist is revealed: Dashaye has been keeping a secret of her own.

episodes.name: The Belt Don't Fit
episodes.overview: Melik is the ultimate supportive boyfriend to Izzy and has been dreaming up an elaborate proposal for her. Suddenly, he's finding strange accessories in his home. Will the truth Tami uncovers derail his marriage plans?

episodes.name: Captain Save a Hoe
episodes.overview: Chris, Tula, and Grace are in a polyamorous relationship, but Chris is having doubts about Grace's affections. Will the throuple be able to survive the results of Tami's investigation?

episodes.name: Hard At Work
episodes.overview: After ten years and two children, Alexia suspects her fiancé, Israel, may no longer be committed. With their engagement off, she turns to Tami wondering if Israel is still grocery shopping with her, or if he's filling someone else's cart.

episodes.name: Twins
episodes.overview: Shay works long hours to support her boyfriend Tommy, but now she fears he's spending that time with someone new. The red flags are piling up, and Shay is beginning to wonder if he is hiding something much bigger.

episodes.name: You Can Call Me Delulu
episodes.overview: Mother of five, Grace, is worried that her husband of three years, Jon, spends too much time out of the house. Is he busy running their trucking company? Or is he on the road to someone else's bed?

episodes.name: A Real-Life cowboy
episodes.overview: Bronson is ready to propose to long-time love, Alisha but her behavior has him thinking that she might be two-stepping with someone else.

episodes.name: The Cards Don't Lie
episodes.overview: Ta'Yiani seeks Tami's services after a tarot card reading fuels her suspicion that her boyfriend Chris is cheating.

episodes.name: She's the Cousin
episodes.overview: Ava has dreamed of starting a family with Maria, her fiancee of four years but it seems like Maria is having second thoughts about starting their IVF journey.

episodes.name: Mommy Mode
episodes.overview: Radio personality Jojo is juggling it all, but Claude's job as a club promoter is keeping him out.

episodes.name: Captial F Friends
episodes.overview: Sunny is determined to marry her live-in boyfriend Woodlief but his history of betrayal has made Sunny suspicious.

episodes.name: You Can't Half-Catch The Fish
episodes.overview: Li met Miguel at a basketball game and they've been a dream team ever since. Li hopes they're getting closer to wedding bells, but Miguel's business trips have become more frequent.

episodes.name: I'm a Narcissist 100%
episodes.overview: When Kate emigrated to the US from Russia, she quickly met her boyfriend Patrick.

episodes.name: Fun, Family, And a Freak
episodes.overview: Katina's love life takes a shocking turn when Tami discovers that her chef boyfriend's secret business is just the appetizer.

episodes.name: Rico Suave
episodes.overview: Emily wants the picture-perfect marriage, just like the one her parents have. So when she starts getting DMs from women claiming to have slept with her long-time boyfriend Rico, Emily turns to Tami for answers.

episodes.name: I Saw You Sucking Toes…
episodes.overview: Derek worked his way into Demoya's heart by helping get her business started but lately, Derek has been working late nights and brushing off her affection.
